title: Closed-form LoFi stack: does closed-form depth raise the effective degree (lift the single-stage ceiling) at a measured training-cost ratio vs dense?

device._note: whitening and ridge on numpy CPU (M107 arithmetic); frozen encode, SVD of the label cross-covariance, and the layer-1/2 VQ encode on the GPU ('cuda' = ROCm/HIP). HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1, gfx1201.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens

sparse.layer0_dictionary: M108/M113 arm (a) exact: prefix of the seeded permutation of the shared 8192-whitened-patch pool - IDENTICAL to the dictionary M113 measured at 0.2153
sparse.layer_rule: Neural LoFi (Dandi et al. 2026) instantiated closed-form: each layer selects the directions of maximal accessible low-degree correlation to the label = the top-k left singular vectors of the label cross-covariance C = F^T Y (centered one-hot), k <= 345 = classes; then whiten (center + per-dim standardize), fit a mini-batch k-means (VQ) dictionary on the whitened projection, triangle-encode (soft assignment over ALL atoms), ridge head. Effective degree ~ 2^(L+1) in pixels: layer 1 = degree 4, layer 2 = degree 8.
sparse._degrees_note: the frozen triangle kernel is degree 2 in pixels; each VQ layer's distance is quadratic in its input, so the effective degree doubles per layer.

head._note: M108's chosen head constant, applied unchanged at every layer.

gate.kill_switch_1_degree: if the best L does not beat L=0 by >= +0.01 overall, closed-form depth does not lift the single-stage ceiling -> B1 fails and the long-term thesis is dead on the quality axis
gate.kill_switch_2_training_cost: the closed-form stack's total training cost to reach its accuracy vs the dense transformer's ledgered training cost; fired (fail) if the ratio < 10x at the registered accuracy point (dense figure from M109 evidence where available, else reported pending)
gate.registered_prediction: the theory (Defilippis et al. 2026: a spectral estimator achieves optimal scaling for hierarchical targets; Bardone et al. 2026: higher cumulants become cheap with shared latent structure) predicts a modest degree-lift; whether it clears +0.01 is the open question. Prior art: Dandi 2605.13612, Defilippis 2602.05846, Bardone 2603.12901, Saiapin 2512.02547, PCANet 1404.3606, Tariyal 1602.00203, Mairal 1009.5358.
